notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only the FFLA list (status, county, coordinates), OpenStreetMap (name, observation tag, 403 m), and the Forest Lookouts list (survey location, Wisconsin Department of Conservation) say anything specific. No build date, design, height, staffing or removal date found. anyplaceamerica.com returned 403 to fetch and was not read. The Forest Lookouts list also has a bare 'THE DUTCHMAN' entry with no detail; not checked whether it is the same site. WJFW's 2015 figure is statewide and is not tied to this tower. Next steps: Wisconsin Historical Society AHI records, Menominee County newspapers, and Conservation Department reports for construction and removal dates.
